name: smwgraphics-hyperion-title-font
title: HYPERION Title - Font
description:
This is a full 26 character (A-Z) version of the title screen font I made for my hack HYPERION.

This font can use vanilla palettes, but the sample level includes a few example palettes to give more ideal results with the dithered gradient effect.

Uses one graphic slot (with room to spare) and for best visual results place over a dark background.
